Budget.description: R7. `remaining = budget − spent − pending` (D4); negative when over-committed.
Budget.title: Budget

Check.description: One decline rule. `passed` is null when skipped (e.g. no market to evaluate).
Check.title: Check

Commitments.description: GET /integrations/quickbooks/commitments: what the business is committed to, not what it spent.
Commitments.title: Commitments

ControllerSignoff.description: The controller's co-sign (or refusal) on a hedge above materiality.
ControllerSignoff.title: ControllerSignoff

Decision.description:
Spec §8. Only `summary` is written by Claude.

`reasons` lists the failed decline checks (1–5) in table order; if none failed it is
`["over_budget"]` when the budget check failed (that pauses, it doesn't decline).
Decision.title: Decision

Exposure.description: Spec §5. Dropped exposures are the same object with `hedgeable: false` and reasons.
Exposure.title: Exposure

Headline.description: 'Unhedged swing $X · hedged swing $Y · cost $Z'. Cost is the premium (R16).
Headline.title: Headline

Hedge.description:
A sized hedge with its embedded decision. Declined hedges keep the attempted sizing;
with no market, the market and sizing fields are null and only `decision` matters.
Hedge.title: Hedge

HedgeLite.description: Within-budget alternative for an over-budget hedge (G8).
HedgeLite.title: HedgeLite

LogEntry.description:
Append-only decision log row (R8, G4). `agent` is null for entries no model wrote
(owner actions, system bookings). `numbers` is the I2 allowed-number set (R18).
LogEntry.title: LogEntry

OwnerHistory.description:
The same exposure's earlier hedges for this business, newest first (at most 5 shown).

`pattern` is set when the owner's recent decisions should change how the desk asks:
"rejected_recently" when the last two decided hedges were both rejected.
OwnerHistory.title: OwnerHistory

QuickBooksConnect.description:
POST /integrations/quickbooks/connect. Demo connects at once (`authorize_url` null); live
returns Intuit's consent URL and stays unconnected until the callback.
QuickBooksConnect.title: QuickBooksConnect

QuickBooksResearch.description: POST /integrations/quickbooks/research: the research protocol on revenue pulled from the books.
QuickBooksResearch.title: QuickBooksResearch

ReconBenchmarkCase.description:
One answer-key row. `planted` rows must be flagged with `expected_cause`; `trap` rows
look odd but are correct, and must not be flagged (`expected_cause` is null).
ReconBenchmarkCase.title: ReconBenchmarkCase

ReconResult.description: C5 shape everywhere (R9); the `reconcile` tool returns it unchanged.
ReconResult.title: ReconResult

ResearchEstimate.description:
One fit of one flag on one period. `pct` is exp(b) − 1 in percent (a stat); the dollars
are that share of the period's mean daily revenue (`mean_revenue`).
ResearchEstimate.title: ResearchEstimate

ResearchReport.description: POST /research. Every figure comes from `stats.research.run`; `summary` is templated.
ResearchReport.title: ResearchReport

Stability.description:
The same §5 model refit on the most recent window only (the holdout split).

`stable` = the recent effect has the train effect's sign AND its 90% CI excludes 0. The
`unstable` decline rule reads it (research hedgesim: taxi rain +$2,212 on train was +$303,
CI crossing 0, on the recent window, and hedging it made income less steady).
Stability.title: Stability
